title: RuleChangeRequest
description: The input of rule.activate, rule.suspend, and rule.retire: the rule's address, the number of the version to move, and the person's reason, which the log keeps (step 28's README, decisions D7, D12, and D13). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that moves a control. The address is dsor://org_456/rule/high-value-payment; its /rule/ part is this tutorial's.

reason.description: Why the version moves, in the person's own words, for the people who read the log.
